title: SSC GD Constable Full Length Mock Test 02 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC GD Constable. 80 Questions | 60 Minutes | Reasoning 20, GA 20, Maths 20, English 20.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 80 questions: General Intelligence and Reasoning 20, General Knowledge and GA 20, Elementary Mathematics 20, English 20.
Har question 2 marks ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.25 marks katenge.
SSC GD Constable latest pattern ke anusar.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
questions.explanation: Doctor works in a hospital; teacher works in a school.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the missing term: 5, 11, 24, 51, 106, ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If COLD is coded as DPME, how is HEAT coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1: H->I, E->F, A->B, T->U so IFBU.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A is the father of B. C is the sister of A. D is the son of C. How is D related to B?
questions.explanation: C is paternal aunt of B; D is son of C, so D is cousin of B.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A man walks 10 km North, turns right 5 km, turns right 10 km. How far is he from start?
questions.explanation: He ends 5 km East of the starting point.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All books are pens. Some pens are pencils. Conclusions: I. Some books are pencils. II. Some pens are books.
questions.explanation: All books are pens implies some pens are books. I does not necessarily follow.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one: Circle, Triangle, Square, Cube
questions.explanation: Cube is three-dimensional; others are two-dimensional shapes.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, Ravi is 12th from the left. Rank from the right is:
questions.explanation: From right = 40 - 12 + 1 = 29.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: ACE, BDF, CEG, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter of the previous group is increased by 1: D, F, H.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Mirror image of the time 2:40 is closest to:
questions.explanation: Approximate mirror of 2:40 is 9:20.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends A,B,C,D,E sit in a row. A is not at ends. B is immediate right of A. C is at left end. Who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: C at left end. A not at end and B right of A so A is in the middle (3rd).

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Best representation of: Men, Fathers, Doctors
options: Fathers subset of Men; Doctors intersect Men
questions.explanation: All fathers are men; some doctors are men or fathers.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If + means x, x means -, - means /, / means +, then 6 + 3 x 2 - 2 / 4 = ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: P > Q = R >= S < T. Which is true?
questions.explanation: P > Q = R >= S implies P > S.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 1 January 2024 was Monday, what day was 1 January 2025?
questions.explanation: 2024 is a leap year so 2 odd days; Monday + 2 = Wednesday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: At what time between 4 and 5 are the hands at right angles first?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Six people sit in a circle facing centre. A opposite D. B immediate right of A. Who is opposite B?
questions.explanation: In a circle, opposite of B is the person sitting immediate right of D.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Two positions of a dice show faces 1,2,3 adjacent and 3,5,6 adjacent. Number opposite 3 is:
questions.explanation: Faces adjacent to 3 cannot be opposite it; remaining face is 4.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: From the letters of CONSTABLE, which is a meaningful word?
questions.explanation: TABLE can be formed from the letters of CONSTABLE.
